leakage_signals: The phrase 'recommended first' implies a ranking that normally depends on traveler-specific priorities, but no such priorities are provided.
The named traveler provides no usable preference history or stated weighting of cost versus schedule and connection reliability.
verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates on the stated facts. B gets home earliest but costs more and has the shortest connection; A is cheaper with longer connection buffers but has two connections and arrives later; C offers a longer single connection but costs more and arrives later than B; D is cheapest and has one connection but arrives substantially later. Selecting a first recommendation requires unstated tradeoffs among fare, arrival time, connection risk, and itinerary simplicity.
